intro: Pao'ka Swiftmountain is a young tauren naturalist stranded among the wild wyverns of Highperch in Thousand Needles. Having traveled south under the guidance of Motega Firemane, his youthful curiosity got the better of him when he ventured too close to a nesting site and ended up cornered in the cliffs.

p: Pao'ka came to the canyon country of Thousand Needles alongside Motega Firemane, eager to catalog and study the dangerous beasts of the canyons. His father had been reluctant to let his son go on such a perilous journey, and Pao'ka's recent misadventure proves those concerns were warranted. Fascinated by the magnificent wyverns inhabiting Highperch, the young scholar crept up the mountain trail behind a solitary tauren totem. Unsurprisingly, the territorial beasts took offense to his intrusion, driving him deep into the crags where he found himself trapped and terrified, unable to slip past the swooping predators to return to Whitereach Post.
